senses.gloss:
नर- + इतर नर- + इतर, m. 1. a superhuman being, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 9. 2. an animal, 3, 13, 49.
 II. the contrary, e. g. दक्षिण-, adj. left, Kumāras. 4, 19.
नारी- + कवच नारी- + कवच, adj. having wives as a coat of mail, protected by wives, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 40.
नर- + देव नर- + देव, and नृ-, m. a king, Man. 11, 82; Rām. 2, 1, 42 Gorr.
नर- + देवत्व नर- + देवत्व, i. e. नर-देव + त्व, n. royalty, Bhāg. P. 1, 3, 22.

नर नर, i. e. नृ + अ, m.
 1. A man; pl. Men, Man. 1, 96.
 2. The Eternal, the divine imperishable spirit pervading the universe, Man. 1, 10.
 3. pl. Certain fabulous beings, MBh. 2, 396.
 4. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 8, 1, 27.
 --Cf. Lat. Nero, Neriene.

नार नार,
 1. i. e. नृ or नर + अ, adj. Belonging to a man, Man. 5, 87.
 II. m. Water (cf. नीर, νηρός, Νηρεύς), Man. 1, 10.
 III. f. नारी नारी, i. e. नृ + ई,
 1. A woman, Man. 1, 32.
 2. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 5, 2, 22.
 --Comp.

नरक नरक, m.
 1. Hell, the infernal regions, Man. 2, 116.
 2. The name of a demon, MBh. 1, 2537.
 3. The name of a country, MBh. 2, 578.
 --Comp.

नारक नारक, i. e. नरक + अ,
 I. adj., f. की, Infernal, hellish, Bhāg. P. 3, 30, 30.
 II. m.
 1. An inhabitant of the infernal regions, 2, 10, 41.
 2. Hell.
नरकाय नरकय, a denomin. derived from नरक by the aff. य, Ātm. To resemble hell, Mārk. P. 8, 117.
नरता नर + ता, f. Human condition, Bhāg. P. 7, 14, 5.
ऽनर्त -नर्त, i. e. नृत् + अ, adj. Dancing, MBh. 13, 1164.

नर्तक नर्तक, i. e. नृत् + अक,
 I. m.
 1. A dancer, Rām. 1, 12, 7.
 2. A dancing-master, MBh. 4, 305.
 II. f. की, A female dancer, Ragh. 19, 14.
 III. adj. Causing to dance, Sāh. D. 74, 17.
 --Comp.

नर्तन नर्तन, i. e. नृत् + अन.
 I. m. A dancer, MBh. 4, 1217.
 II. n. Dancing, Man. 2, 178.
नर्तयितृ नर्तयितृ, i. e. नृत्, Caus., + तृ, m. A dancing-master, Mālav. d. 24.

नर्द् नर्द्, i. 1, Par. (also Ātm., Hariv. 11936), To roar, MBh. 1, 4114. []
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. नर्दित,
 1. n. Roaring, Rām. 4, 8, 38.
 2. m. The name of one of the dice, Mṛcch. 33, 10.
 --Frequent. नानर्द्, To sound aloud, Hariv. 8064 (anomal. Ātm. नानर्दमान).
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To roar at, MBh. 6, 2738.
 --With आ आ, आनर्दित, n. Roaring, Rām. 2, 42, 20.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To greet with roaring, crying, MBh. 8, 1806.
 2. To roar for, 12, 5777.
 --With वि वि, To roar, MBh. 8, 2468.
 --With अनुवि अनु-वि, To answer with roaring, Hariv. 14559.
† नर्ब् नर्ब्, i. 1, Par. = नम्ब्.

नर्मद नर्मद, i. e. नर्मन्-द,
 1. adj. Causing pleasure, Somad. Nal. 128.
 2. f. दा, The name of a river, the modern Nerbudda, MBh. 2, 371; personified, 15, 550.
नर्मन् नर्मन्, probably नर्द् + मन्, n. Jest, sport, MBh. 1, 1000.
नर्मय नर्मय, a denomin. derived from नर्मन् by अय, Par. To exhilarate by jesting, Kām. Nītis. 7, 42.

नर्य नर्य, i. e. नर + य,
 1. adj. Manly (ved.).
 2. A proper name (?), Chr. 296, 9 = Rigv. i. 112, 9.
नर- + नाथ नर- + नाथ, m. a king, Rām. 2, 68, 55 Gorr.
नारकिन् नारकिन्, i. e. नारक + इन्, m. An inhabitant of hell, Prab. 46, 3.
नारङ्ग नारङ्ग, m. An orange tree, Suśr. 1, 209, 6.
नारद नारद, m. A Devarṣi, i. e. a celestial Ṛṣi; in epic poetry the messenger of the gods, MBh. 1, 2048.
नारसिंह नारसिंह, i. e. नर-सिंह + अ, adj., f. ही, Referring, belonging, etc., to Viṣṇu in his incarnation as man-lion, MBh. 3, 15837.
नाराच नाराच (perhaps नर-अञ्च् + अ), m. A kind of arrow, MBh. 1, 5522.

नारायण नारायण, probably नर + आयन,
 I. m.
 1. The first living being, identified with Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 7, 9447; Man. 1, 10.
 2. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 24.
 II. adj. Referring, belonging to Nārāyaṇa. MBh. 1, 337.
 III. f. णी, patronym. name of Indrasenā, MBh. 4, 651.
नारायणमय नारायण + मय, adj. Consisting of Nārāyaṇa, Bhāg. P. 6, 8, 4.
नारायणीय नारायणीय, i. e. नारायण + ईय, adj. Referring to Nārāyaṇa, MBh. 12, 13422.

नारिकेर नारिकेर, and नारिकेल नारिकेल, m. The cocoa-nut, Suśr. 2, 108, 9; Rām. 3, 39, 12.
 --Cf. नालिकेर.
नारी नारी, see नार.
नारीक नारी + क, a substitute for नारी at the end of comp. adj., Rām. 2, 109, 22 Gorr.
नारीमय नारी + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting in wives, Bhartṛ. 1, 98.
नर- + पशु नर- + पशु, and पुरुष-, m. a beast-like man.
नर- + माला नर- + माल, f. ला, a chaplet of human skulls, Dev. 7, 6.
नर- + मेध नर- + मेध, नृ-, पुरुष-, m. the sacrifice of a man, Rām. 1, 63, 6 Gorr. (नर-); Kathās. 26, 238 (पुरुष-).
नर- + यान नर- + यान, n. 1. a carriage drawn by men, MBh. 12, 1383. 2. -याण (with ण्), riding on a man, Pañc. iii. d. 248.
नारी- + यान नारी- + यान, n. a carriage for women, Man. 3, 52.
नर-वीर- + लोक नर-वीर- + लोक, m. mankind, Hit. iv. d. 80.
नर- + वाहन नर- + वाहन, adj. drawn by men, epithet and name of Kuvera, MBh. 3, 8358.
नर- + वाहिन् नर- + वाहिन्, i. e. नरवाह + इन्, adj. drawn by men, Nal. 17, 23.
नर-वर- + वृषभ नर-वर- + वृषभ, m. a most preeminent man, Pañc. i. d. 204.
नर्तन- + शाला नर्तन- + शाला, f. a dancing-room, MBh. 4, 696.
नर्मसचिव नर्मसचिव, i. e. नर्मन्-, m. a princes's companion, whose business it is to amuse him by jokes, Kām. Nītis. 5, 20; a favourite, Mālat. 37, 4.
नारी-दृश्-नीरज- + स्तवकित नारी-दृश्-नीरज- + स्तवकित, adj. having as (i. e. instead of) clusters of blossoms the lotus-like eyes of the women, Rājat. 5, 480.
नर- + हरि नर- + हरि, and नृ-, m. Viṣṇu, in his fourth avatāra, as a lionheaded man, Bhāg. P. 5, 18, 7; 7, 8, 27. []
